G2104863.description: Noro is a town in the Western Province of Solomon Islands. It has 7,204 inhabitants as of 2019, making it the second largest town in the country behind the Honiara Urban Area.

G2105575.description: Munda is the largest settlement on the island of New Georgia in the Western Province of Solomon Islands, and consists of a number of villages. It is located at the southwestern tip (called Munda Point) of the western end of New Georgia, and the large Roviana Lagoon is just offshore.

G2108502.description: Honiara ( HON-nee-AH-rə) is the capital and largest city of Solomon Islands, situated on the northwestern coast of Guadalcanal. As of 2019, it had a population of 129,569 people.

G2108857.description: Gizo is the capital of the Western Province in Solomon Islands. The town had a population of 4,620 as of 2019.

G2109528.description: Buala is a town in Solomon Islands located on Santa Isabel Island, which is the longest island in Solomon Islands. Buala consists of Jejevo Station and Buala Village.

G2109701.description: Auki, sometimes styled ʻAoke, is the provincial capital of Malaita Province in Solomon Islands. It is situated on the northern end of Langa Langa Lagoon on the north-west coast of Malaita.

G2178750.description: Lata is the provincial capital of Temotu Province, Solomon Islands. As of 2019, it had 1,806 inhabitants.

G2178753.description: Kirakira, also spelt Kira Kira, is the provincial capital of the Makira-Ulawa Province in Solomon Islands. Kirakira is located on the north coast of Makira (formerly San Cristobal), the largest island of the province.
